title: sideritis syriaca subsp. nusairiensis
intro: Sideritis syriaca subsp. nusairiensis, commonly known as the Nusairi Ironwort, is a plant species belonging to the Sideritis genus, native to the Middle East. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which can help to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and fight off infections. The therapeutic actions of Sideritis syriaca subsp. nusairiensis include its ability to act as a diuretic, antispasmodic, and expectorant, making it useful in treating conditions such as urinary tract infections, muscle spasms, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are found in its leaves and flowers.
